items.notes: CSS pseudo-element -webkit-inner-spin-button not in any stylesheet. Inline MozAppearance only fixes Firefox. Chrome/Safari show spinners. Fix: 3 lines in App.css. Related: CR-047.

items.title: Add Stock — Duplicate Item Rows Submittable (hasDuplicates Gate Missing)
items.notes: validRows does not exclude duplicate itemId rows. isFormValid has no hasDuplicates check. User can select same item twice and submit — creates overlapping purchase records. Fix: add hasDuplicates derived from itemIdCount; gate isFormValid. Related: CR-047.

items.title: Add Stock — Single Payment Amount Not Auto-Filled From Grand Total
items.notes: legs[0].amount never synced to fullPayableTotal. User can type any value (e.g. 1000, -9) for a 0.80 purchase. API always uses fullPayableTotal correctly but display is misleading. Fix: useEffect syncing legs[0].amount when fullPayableTotal changes, only when legs.length === 1. Related: CR-047.

items.title: CR-050 Rectification — Header cards not compact, only 1 item shown, manual-add still present
Dispatch Screen — Keyboard Navigation Gaps (B1: search Enter, B2: qty Enter, B3: disabled guard, B4: auto-select on qty entry)
items.notes: B1: search <input> line 457 has no onKeyDown — Enter does nothing. B2: qty <Input> line 741 has no onKeyDown — Enter does nothing. B3: included:false default (line 253) + disabled={!row.included} (line 747) + row-click INPUT guard (line 700) means focused qty is still disabled after B1 fires. B4: qty onChange (line 746) does not auto-set included:true — storekeeper must manually click checkbox before typing. Combined fix: remove disabled, auto-check in qty onChange, add onKeyDown to search (+8 lines) and qty (+6 lines). All fixes in 1 file.

items.title: Add Stock — Invoice # field missing (not wired in form or payload)
items.notes: addPurchase() payload (lines 207-233) has no invoice_number key. No invoiceNumber state. No input field. api.js unchanged — raw payload passthrough. Fix: 3 additions to AddStockPurchaseForm only. Open Q: duplicate-check warning (same as CR-040) or store-only? | Q1 ANSWERED (2026-10-19): store-only — no duplicate check warning. Invoice can repeat across vendors (owner confirmed in CR-051 context).

items.title: Purchase Report — Unit Price shows per-gram API value (B1) + Split payment legs not rendered (B2)
items.notes: B1: line 246 renders r.unit_price (per-gram) directly — fix: line_total/stock_quantity_raw. B2: lines 251-255 render r.Payment_Type only; r.partial_payments[] (G-039 confirmed) never accessed — fix: conditional render legs when Payment_Type=partial && partial_payments.length>0. Both 1-file fixes.

items.title: Add Stock — Expiry Enter jumps to next row Qty instead of Item search
items.notes: handleKeyDown(expiry) line 682: getElementById(qty-{idx+1}) focuses wrong field. Item combobox has data-testid=item-select-{idx}, no id. Fix: querySelector([data-testid=item-select-{idx+1}]). Also: onTabFromLast branch (line 681) adds a row but never focuses new item-select — fix with setTimeout 50ms (same pattern as line 718). ~6 lines changed. | SECONDARY ROOT CAUSE (2026-10-19): .focus() alone does not open the Popover. CommandInput is portal-mounted only when open=true. Fix also needs .click() after .focus() at both call sites (lines ~694, ~697). Investigation: INVESTIGATION_20261019_BUG057_POPOVER.md

items.title: Review Screen — Fare + Invoice # Not Shown in Confirm Header
items.notes: confirmMode review screen header (lines 302–321) shows Vendor/Date/Payment only. Fare and Invoice# are entered in the form but absent from the review. Grand Total uses fullPayableTotal (correct) but no subtotal breakdown (items + fare) is shown. Fix: add Fare + Invoice# to header grid; add items subtotal + fare line before Grand Total. SMALL scope, 1 file ~10 lines.

items.title: Add Stock — BATCH Enter Skips Date Field (keyup transfer bug)
items.notes: SpreadsheetRow: pressing Enter on batch field focuses the expiry date input. But Chromium fires keyup on the newly-focused element, so the date input's onKeyUp immediately fires handleKeyDown("expiry", Enter) → advances to next row before user types date. Fix: add justFocused ref in SpreadsheetRow; onFocus sets it true; onKeyUp skips if justFocused is true. Note: native <input type=date> sub-field (mm/dd/yyyy) navigation uses Tab/ArrowRight not Enter — cannot step through sub-fields with Enter without a custom picker. SMALL scope, 1 file ~5 lines.

items.title: Dispatch — Multi-Batch Source Selection Not Wired (FEFO multi-alloc broken)
items.notes: fefoAutoSelect() correctly computes multi-alloc (e.g. 5kg seg_A + 5kg seg_B). But autoSource=null when allocs>1 (line 221) → sourceSelector=null. The multi-batch <select> UI renders but onChange overwrites to a single segment_id (line 788). Payload sends source_selector:null for multi-batch items. Fix requires: (1) API probe — can items[] accept same source_inventory_master_id twice with different source_selector+qty? If yes → split multi-alloc into multiple payload items (Option B). If no → file G-040 (backend gap for array source_selector). API probe needs live dispatch test in dev env before PLANNING can proceed. MEDIUM scope.

items.title: Purchase Report — Fare Column Missing + Summary Excludes Fare (NO-CODE)
items.notes: Live API probe confirmed: PUR-828-20261020-8011 has tot_fair=200, tot_amount=1200, line_total=1000. Amount column (line 252) uses line_total (items only) — fare excluded. Summary total (line 55) uses d.total_amount (API root) which per G-038 = sum(line_totals), also excludes fare. Fix (when approved): (1) Add Fare column — show r.tot_fair on first row per transaction_id, dash elsewhere (avoids double-count on multi-item purchases). (2) Summary: deduplicate by transaction_id → sum unique tot_amount. SMALL scope 1 file ~15 lines. OWNER INSTRUCTION: NO-CODE, SKIP GATE — Gate 1 only until owner gives GO. Investigation complete: INVESTIGATION_20261020_BUG061_DESIGN.md — proposed transaction-grouped table design, fare pill on header, correctTotal useMemo. Awaiting owner GO for Planning+Implementation. | Design revision: Option B (dedicated Fare column) chosen by owner 2026-10-20. Plan: BUG-061_ARTIFACT_3b_IMPL_PLAN_OPTION_B.md

items.title: Dispatch — Source Selector Shows Only FEFO Batch (All Batches Not Selectable)
items.notes: The SOURCE (FEFO) <select> dropdown is built from fefoAllocs[] — only the FEFO-chosen batch appears as an option. segments_preview[] has all available batches but they are never offered as choices. Storekeeper cannot override FEFO and pick a different batch. Fix: replace fefoAllocs.map(<1-option select>) with a single <select> listing all segments_preview entries; FEFO batch pre-selected; onChange sets sourceSelector + sourceManuallySet=true. Add display_qty availability note when selected segment has less qty than send qty. When only 1 segment exists: static badge (no dropdown). SMALL scope, 1 file ~25 lines. Distinct from BUG-060 (multi-batch split). Investigation: INVESTIGATION_20261020_DISPATCH_SEGMENT_SELECTOR.md
